result:
I fixed the bug, but I couldn't run the tests. `python` isn't on the path here, and `python3` has no pytest installed.

The plain-text score parser in `anthrouter/model_router.py` (around line 1233) checked `0 <= value < 100`. That rejected a reply of exactly `100` as unparseable, so the router fell back to the requested model. I changed the check to `0 <= value <= 100`.

The JSON parser next to it, `parse_classifier_score_json`, already documents its range as 0–100, so I left it alone.
